instruction: Same tree for two equal binary trees -> True.
response:
Recursive: both must match at root; left subtrees must match; right subtrees must match.

```python
def is_same_tree(p, q):
    if not p and not q:
        return True
    if not p or not q:
        return False
    return (p.val == q.val
            and is_same_tree(p.left, q.left)
            and is_same_tree(p.right, q.right))
```
